_what_this_is: Task-2 surrogate. NOT a re-run. The literal decisive test (retrain canonical spread_v2 with dist_to_fire_m removed) requires the git-ignored raw FIRMS/ERA5/DEM bundle, which is absent, so it cannot be executed. Committed-data natural experiment reported instead.

provenance.raw_data_status: UNAVAILABLE — data/raw/ holds only .gitkeep; .gitignore excludes data/raw/** (FIRMS/ERA5/DEM downloaded at run time). $WFG_FIRMS_DIR unset; no firms_data.zip on disk. Live LOFO re-run is therefore IMPOSSIBLE. All numbers below are read from committed git blobs.

blocked_live_test.requested: retrain HistGradientBoostingClassifier (seed 20250603) on the LOFO folds with dist_to_fire_m dropped from FEATURE_COLUMNS, recompute permutation importance + pooled/per-fire AUC

committed_natural_experiment.note: dist_to_fire_m is present in BOTH committed runs; it is a top-2 permutation feature in each, i.e. NOT an artifact unique to Run B.

interpretation.dist_carries_model_in_both: dist_to_fire_m rank #2 (0.0600) in Run A and #1 (0.0717) in Run B — sizeable, legitimate spread-physics signal in both; it is computed from the CURRENT active mask (features.py geometry_layers on active=cur.cumulative_mask), so no future-label leakage.
interpretation.44x_finding_is_severity_vs_direction_not: severity_over_direction_ratio measures SEVERITY_FEATURES sum / wind_alignment. dist_to_fire_m is neither. The ratio's drop 43.69x -> 9.27x is driven by severity_sum HALVING (0.1018 -> 0.0572) and wind_alignment RISING (0.00233 -> 0.00616), a DATA-driven shift, not the presence of dist.
interpretation.qualitative_finding_survives_both: severity dominates direction by ~44x (Run A) and ~9.3x (Run B) — an order of magnitude in BOTH; the headline 'severity, not wind direction' claim is directionally robust, only its magnitude changed with the data.
interpretation.cannot_run_removal: Whether days_since_rain returns to strict #1 with dist dropped is not decidable from committed data alone; the retrain is blocked.
